fusion: exact symbol first; explicit structural answers next; interleaved semantic/lexical ranks for remaining candidates with RRF k=20 tie-break; greedy whole-record byte selection
lexical: case-folded identifier splitting and stopword-filtered OR-token BM25 over source declarations; exact full-symbol matches prioritized
mutation_freshness: Use revision-A derived indexes for requested B and bypass revision/hash/symbol/edge validation
mutation_isolation: Use all-domain candidates and bypass scoped filtering before retrieval and packet emission
no_tuning: Queries, source/oracles, selection and thresholds freeze before comparing outputs; report FAIL if unmet.
semantic: local BAAI/bge-m3 dense cosine over AST declaration text; rounded scores for deterministic tie breaking
structural: real pinned Graphify extraction, bounded relation lookup/path expansion, source-AST relation revalidation
threshold_scope: At least two distinct required targets gained across the eight non-lexical queries in EACH revision; repeated target across queries counts once. No exact loss; all combined required targets must survive packet bounding.
